purpose: Presentation redesign of the local employee-only auto shop interface; originals preserved.

prompts.catalog:
Redesign this screenshot as a polished, high-end desktop application UI presentation for a real LOCAL auto parts shop inventory system used ONLY by employees. This is an explicitly authorized new visual concept: freely change layout, typography, colors and spacing. Keep the core functions: inventory catalog, search by SKU or name, brand/category filters, stock, prices, selecting a part and adding it to a sales receipt.

Create one immaculate FLAT FRONT-ON application screenshot, wide landscape around 16:9 at high resolution, with NO laptop, perspective, outer decoration, marketing headlines or browser frame. Contemporary product design quality with disciplined grids, exceptional whitespace, subtly rounded 8px panels, hairline slate dividers, highly legible refined Cyrillic sans-serif. All interface text in correct Russian. Midnight graphite background #10141f, slightly lighter panels #181e2c, cool off-white text, quiet gray secondary text. Sparing blue #5474ed / purple #8071ec accents for selection and primary actions; muted emerald only for stock status. NO cyan neon, gradients covering panels, heavy shadows, excessive pills, cartoon illustration or generic bento tiles.

Layout: consistent fixed left sidebar ~200px across entire height; a small abstract geometric icon beside “Магазин”, subtitle “Локальная система”. Simple outlined icons, sections “Каталог”, “Подбор”, “Остатки”, “Управление”; Каталог selected with subdued indigo background and a slender accent marker. Bottom “Локально” status dot and employee account “Сотрудник”. Content region with generous 32px margins and clear baseline alignment.

Top: small breadcrumb “Магазин / Каталог”, restrained header “Каталог запчастей” and subtitle “Поиск по складу и подбор деталей”. One quiet utility control top right “Чек · 2”. Under header, one long search field “Артикул или название детали” and clean dropdown filters “Все бренды”, “Все категории”. Secondary row “5 405 товаров” and compact sort control.

Main area: a meticulously aligned, professional inventory TABLE occupying the left ~70% and one narrow selected-part detail panel on right. Table columns “Наименование”, “Артикул”, “Остаток”, “Цена”; six generously spaced rows, thin dividers, numbers right aligned, product names as clear primary text with brand as small muted secondary line. Plausible rows: “Масляный фильтр” RENAULT / 7700274177 / 74 шт. / 400 ₽; “Шайба сливной пробки” MASUMA / MDP0023 / 50 шт. / 50 ₽; “Тормозные колодки” HI-Q / SP1243 / 46 шт. / 1 050 ₽; “Масляный фильтр” FINWHALE / LF502 / 34 шт. / 400 ₽; “Свеча зажигания” BOSCH / 0242235666 / 32 шт. / 250 ₽; “Воздушный фильтр” MANN / C27030 / 18 шт. / 890 ₽. First row selected with subtle indigo tint. Bottom neat pagination “1 — 6 из 5 405”, small arrow buttons. Do not draw miniature thumbnails for every row.

Right selected-detail panel: tiny label “ВЫБРАННАЯ ДЕТАЛЬ”, large tidy name “Масляный фильтр”, a very restrained monochrome line illustration or simple realistic cutout of a black oil filter in a small calm area. Below a two-column key/value list “Артикул / 7700274177”, “Бренд / RENAULT”, “На складе / 74 шт.”. A separate price line “400 ₽”. Compact compatibility block “Применяемость” with “Renault Logan, Sandero, Duster”. Bottom one blue-purple solid button “Добавить в чек” and a quiet text link “Спецификация”. Ensure excellent visual hierarchy, balance and aligned controls. Make this feel like a carefully art-directed real professional internal tool, with very crisp typography and clean readable content.

CRITICAL: completely remove and do not include ANY occurrence, logo, badge, URL, watermark or spelling variation of Armtek, Армтек, Stparts, Стпартс. Do not claim cloud access, public service, user metrics or business results. Screenshot only.
prompts.analogs:

Fixed sidebar name “Магазин”, subtitle “Локальная система”; nav “Каталог”, “Подбор”, “Остатки”, “Управление”; bottom “Локально” and “Сотрудник”. Update selected nav to fit this screen. Flat front-on wide landscape desktop application screenshot around 16:9 at high resolution. NO device, perspective, outer browser, decorative frame, marketing text, graphs without purpose, neon cyan or excessive pills. All Russian text should be crisp, legible and correctly spelled. This is an authorized visual redesign; information can be reorganized and simplified. Maintain an excellent aligned grid, restrained professional density and generous whitespace. Internal LOCAL employee-only solution, not public SaaS. CRITICAL: remove and NEVER include Armtek, Армтек, Stparts, Стпартс or any spelling/URL/logo/badge variation.
SCREEN: “Подбор аналогов”. Transform the old cluttered modal into a beautifully structured FULL main application workspace. Sidebar “Подбор” selected. Breadcrumb “Магазин / Подбор”. Main title “Подбор аналогов”, muted subtitle “От оригинальной детали к наличию на складе”. Top right the same blue “Чек · 2” button as anchor.
Below header a clean original-part summary horizontal panel: outlined part icon, small label “ОРИГИНАЛЬНАЯ ДЕТАЛЬ”, title “Свеча зажигания”, secondary “HYUNDAI / KIA · 0K55818110”; far right quiet neutral status “Нет на складе”. Under summary a neat two-tab navigation “Все аналоги · 191” and “В наличии · 2”, latter selected in subtle indigo; search field aligned on right “Артикул или бренд”.
Main layout a wide clean table left and narrow part-detail panel right, aligned with anchor. Table header “Наименование”, “Артикул”, “Остаток”, “Цена”. Display ONLY TWO available rows with very good spacing and clarity: “Свеча зажигания”, brand “NGK”, SKU “4291”, stock “1 шт.” emerald, price “800 ₽”; second row “Свеча зажигания”, brand “NGK”, SKU “7100”, stock “2 шт.”, price “1 850 ₽”. First row selected muted indigo. Above table small contextual line “2 аналога есть в магазине”. Below table understated source-free explanatory note “Наличие проверено по складской базе”. Use balanced whitespace or a calm compact explanatory block below list “Оригинальный номер → Сопоставление → Наличие в магазине”, thin hairline connections; no giant empty screen, no metrics.
Right detail card “ВЫБРАННЫЙ АНАЛОГ”, title “Свеча зажигания”, one refined small spark plug cutout or line illustration in calm area, key/value rows “Бренд / NGK”, “Артикул / 4291”, “На складе / 1 шт.”, price “800 ₽”, blue-purple “Добавить в чек”. Short muted compatibility “Ford Probe, Mazda 626, Opel Vectra” if space. Show no supplier names. Make this feel like the second page of the approved anchor, meticulously composed.
